title: Node Census Output
description: Stage A of section-ir-0.7: a flat census of every argumentatively load-bearing Method, Entity, and Metric node, with no relations. Context, Condition, and Claim are not nodes; they are born during content extraction.

spine_summary.description: Summary of the paper's contribution and argument structure

central_contribution.description: One sentence naming the main contribution.

argument_flow.description: One sentence describing how context, claim, method, and evidence fit together.

nodes.description: Flat list of referenceable nodes; node_id is reused verbatim as the final unit id.

type.description: Node type: Method, Entity, or Metric

name.description: Short name of the node as the paper refers to it

gloss.description: One short phrase describing the node

entity_class.description: For an Entity node, one of: dataset, benchmark, model, task, hardware. Empty string "" for Method and Metric nodes.

source_scope.description: Section markers where the node appears, e.g. ['§3']

salience.description: must = load-bearing for the contribution; should = adds nuance

is_root.description: True for the single document-level root Method; false otherwise
